title: Check Environment Variable
description: Verify that a required environment variable is configured.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

VARIABLE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$VARIABLE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 VARIABLE_NAME" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -n "${!VARIABLE:-}" ]]; then
    echo "$VARIABLE is set."
else
    echo "ERROR: $VARIABLE is not set." >&2
    exit 1
fi
